name: correlated adaptive shrinkage (cashr)
model_likelihood: X_j = theta_j + s_j Z_j; theta_j ~ g; Z_j | omega ~ f; observations conditionally independent given f,g
prior: point mass at zero plus zero-mean Gaussian mixture on fixed scale grid; conservative null-proportion penalty; weighted absolute-value noise-coefficient penalty
inference_algorithm: alternating constrained penalized likelihood optimization of pi and omega; then plug-in posterior inference
estimand: marginal empirical Bayes posterior distributions for effects theta_j
data_input: observations X_j and assumed-known standard deviations s_j
tunable_settings: component scale grid and K; derivative truncation L=10; nonnegativity grid; gamma=10 and rho=0.5; lambda_0=10 and lambda_k=0 for k>0
component_claims: model_likelihood=cashr:c04; prior=cashr:c05; prior=cashr:c12; inference_algorithm=cashr:c06; estimand=cashr:c07; data_input=cashr:c02

name: exchangeable correlated noise (ECN)
model_likelihood: Z_j | omega iid f; f = standard Gaussian density plus standardized Gaussian-derivative expansion
prior: weighted absolute-value penalty on noise coefficients encoding decay with derivative order
inference_algorithm: convex constrained penalized maximum likelihood using an interior-point method
estimand: estimated noise coefficients omega and resulting fitted noise density f
data_input: observed correlated null scores Z_j for standalone noise fitting
tunable_settings: derivative truncation L=10; nonnegativity grid; penalty gamma=10 and rho=0.5
